items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution due to improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. It has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, but it is recommended to apply the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to these updates.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (including unauthenticated customer account takeover)
items.summary: This security update addresses seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
